Categories.Title: Getting started
Categories.Description: Small, complete maps that show the basics: a source schema, a target schema, a map and a sample to run it on.

Categories.Title: Loops and conditions
Categories.Description: Maps that repeat over lists, sort and filter them, and only write parts of the output when a condition holds.

Categories.Title: Working with variables
Categories.Description: Maps that keep values in map variables while they run, for totals, counters and values used in more than one place.

Categories.Title: Advanced
Categories.Description: Larger maps with loops, conditions, variables and custom functions, for users who know the editor.

Samples.Title: Use XMap function GetMetadata
Samples.Description: Learn how to use GetMetadata function. GetMetadata is used when you want to pass additional inputs to map which is not available in the input message
